APPROVE. The loop and the `known == 0` check moved into `Evaluate` unchanged, and `Read` still returns on the first readable file, so behaviour is the same. Both `Read` and `Evaluate` should now be well under 15, and the new private static method has no visible build problems.

I only had the diff, not the full file, so I assumed `name` is a non-nullable `string` in `Read` and that `ReadBool` and `CoreOptions` are accessible from the new method. I did not run a build.
